answers.core: Because it requires modifying godot_app_delegate.mm, which is engine-side code and cannot be accessed or modified by a regular add-on.
answers.workaround: While a workaround using Swizzling is technically possible, it would introduce significant complexity and potential stability issues. To keep the codebase maintainable, I would prefer to avoid this approach.

title: Change GDTApplicationDelegate initialization from +load to +initialize to prevent registration loss on iOS
